report: Step13J final supplement — packaging prerequisites and official model contracts
scope: Read-only source and public official documentation review. Prior deployment plan retained; unfulfilled conditions updated only.
source_baseline: Step13J sealed worktree; prior product/test SHA db9e4df953764fe36260d89e8d68eec1687b3c5a; later CI-only checkpoint 2c785afbb32e6d514343c1ec991698f3681bfa39.
verdict: CONDITIONAL — documentation and static contracts verified; actual EXE and live model/account/billing remain NOT VERIFIED.

packaging_tools.documentation: Python3.14 support introduced in6.15.0; Windows build required for Windows executable; bundles interpreter.
4.2 announces official Python3.14 support. Windows requires supported compiler; manual lists MSVC2022+, Clang-cl and Zig. MinGW64 on Python3.13+ remains experimental.

unfulfilled_deployment_gates.finding: Current launcher discovers Python3.12/3.14, creates a venv and invokes pip editable installation. No installer/spec/Nuitka build definition identified. Python3.14.7 source tests do not establish executable compatibility.
unfulfilled_deployment_gates.needed: Step15-approved tool selection, pinned Python3.14.7 build, clean Windows no-Python smoke test.

unfulfilled_deployment_gates.finding: SAPI spawns sys.executable -m; autorun targets .venv/Scripts/python.exe. These paths assume an interpreter. Frozen child dispatch, normal exit and update reentry remain unverified.
unfulfilled_deployment_gates.needed: Explicit frozen-compatible worker/autorun entrypoints, no accidental main-app recursion, owned child cleanup and restart protection; preserve existing approval boundaries.

unfulfilled_deployment_gates.finding: FFmpeg/ffprobe resolved by explicit path/env/PATH; libx264 encoding used. Templates/static assets/migrations/fonts are declared as package data, but frozen resource discovery, tzdata, pywin32/Pillow/SQLite DLLs and optional ONNX/Supertonic models are not packaged or tested.
unfulfilled_deployment_gates.needed: Build manifest and integrity/license/version checks; no developer paths or actual user models/media bundled.

unfulfilled_deployment_gates.finding: Official licensing is LGPL2.1+ by default; enabled GPL components change the binary license. libx264 is a GPL component; enable-nonfree binaries are not redistributable. Current NewsFlow uses libx264, so the chosen redistributable FFmpeg build and corresponding source/notices/build configuration need review. This does not decide the license of the separate NewsFlow application.
unfulfilled_deployment_gates.needed: Choose exact redistributable FFmpeg/ffprobe binaries, record build flags/license/source availability and ship required notices. Do not assume an arbitrary FFmpeg download is LGPL-only.

unfulfilled_deployment_gates.status: TEST TOOLS DISTINCT FROM PRODUCT RUNTIME
unfulfilled_deployment_gates.finding: Node/Playwright are used by GUI validation tooling, not listed product dependencies or normal product imports. Product serves a loopback GUI and OAuth uses the system webbrowser. Chrome155 is a tested browser, not a mandatory bundled Chrome contract. Optional Codex/Claude CLI features have their own external dependencies.
unfulfilled_deployment_gates.needed: Decide supported user-browser launch experience and verify it in clean-PC packaging. Do not bundle test driver/profile/cookies or make Node mandatory without a product need.

unfulfilled_deployment_gates.status: SOURCE SEPARATION PRESENT / REAL MULTIUSER NOT VERIFIED
unfulfilled_deployment_gates.finding: Default data root is current-user LocalAppData/NewsFlowAI; DPAPI uses current-user protection without LOCAL_MACHINE. Environment data-root overrides and shared/global environment keys can still create shared configuration. Default Windows ACL, different-user SID isolation, credential restore and independent ledger behavior require native tests.
unfulfilled_deployment_gates.needed: Retain per-user layout, prohibit accidental packaged shared secrets and test distinct standard users; API-key direct-entry/backend/hybrid policy remains undecided.

unfulfilled_deployment_gates.finding: Loopback restriction, signed CSRF, Origin checks, CSP and exclusive Windows socket are present. These are not local-user identity authentication; GET can obtain a CSRF cookie. Same-host user access to GUI/media requires explicit policy. Fixed8765 conflicts fail closed in source; native simultaneous-user/instance behavior is not proven.
unfulfilled_deployment_gates.needed: Approved bootstrap/local-auth and sensitive-GET access policy; per-user port and OAuth redirect compatibility; actual Windows duplicate-run tests.

unfulfilled_deployment_gates.finding: No actual installer, code-signing, clean-PC installation, data-preserving update/removal or frozen rollback proof. Startup may migrate/recover/start workers.
unfulfilled_deployment_gates.needed: Step15–18 separately approved builds/tests; same-point data/code restore and unknown-request no-replay protection. No installer or operating update performed here.

cost_boundary.finding: Public model pages mix undiscounted, promotional and configuration-specific pricing. Seedance2.0 page describes video-token metering, while existing model settings generally store per-second rates. No public display is treated as the user's authenticated quote or actual bill.
cost_boundary.needed: Future explicit real-call scope must freeze model/mode/resolution/seconds/reference transmission and obtain a suitable supplier estimate; do not silently map Seedance token pricing to arbitrary per-second guesses.
